<thought>The mass spectrum shows a prominent ion at m/z 121.05, which likely corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈120.04 Da. This mass matches well with the formula C₈H₈O (exact monoisotopic mass 120.057 Da). The observed M+1 intensity (~8 %) is consistent with a molecule containing about eight carbons (each carbon contributes ~1 % to the M+1 peak). A plausible structure with formula C₈H₈O is phenylacetaldehyde, an aromatic aldehyde. Its SMILES representation is “O=CCc1ccccc1”. This SMILES is valid and matches the inferred formula and unsaturation (DBE = 5). Therefore, the SMILES string for the sample is:

<thought>O=CCc1ccccc1</thought>
<final_answer>O=CCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
